title: The SECOND decade of real plaintexts at 4096: when the plaintexts fitted come from other files of the same five real families, does the encoder signal keep rising at the record's rate, and does the boosted model keep its lead over a hand-writable linear rule or does the linear rule overtake it? 0021's three fixed recipes (M4, L3, D1) on seven nested rungs (r1: 130 plaintexts, 3344 rows; r2: 258 plaintexts, 6635 rows; r3: 515 plaintexts, 13207 rows; r4: 1029 plaintexts, 26346 rows; r5: 2058 plaintexts, 52766 rows; r6: 4116 plaintexts, 105214 rows; r7: 8232 plaintexts, 210751 rows): 0023's four rungs row for row, then three exact doublings of every family from 0024's corpus of 7574 new pinned plaintexts nested on 0021's block; each role fitted once per rung and scored once on 0018's scoring set. Clauses: the model's second-decade slope >= 0.005 per doubling of plaintexts with a cluster-bootstrap 95 percent lower bound above 0; the lead of the model over the logistic at the top rung read by a sealed paired-interval rule. Rungs 1..4 must reproduce 0023's readings and rung 4 0021's.

scope.one_line: Two fit corpora sealed by array hash (0021's: 26346 rows, 1029 plaintexts with rows; 0024's: 193926 rows, 7574 plaintexts with rows, new files of the same five families), two seeds (20260825 for everything 0023 sealed, 20260917 for the new pool, the new rungs' row order, the null control and the bootstrap), three FIXED recipes (0021's M4, L3, D1), seven nested rungs of plaintexts (r1: 130 plaintexts, 3344 rows; r2: 258 plaintexts, 6635 rows; r3: 515 plaintexts, 13207 rows; r4: 1029 plaintexts, 26346 rows; r5: 2058 plaintexts, 52766 rows; r6: 4116 plaintexts, 105214 rows; r7: 8232 plaintexts, 210751 rows; 5.984659 doublings in all, 1.8016 decades; the second decade 3.0 doublings, 0.9031 decades), one fit per role per rung, one null control on the top rung, one scoring set (the sealed 260000-row evaluation set plus the whole 61409-row extension corpus), one scoring per role: 25 fits, 25 scorings.
scope.why_this_preregistration_exists: 0023 read REAL_CURVE_RISES: over 130 to 1029 real plaintexts the model rose 0.007344 per doubling (interval [0.006199, 0.00846]), the standardised logistic 0.009551 ([0.008478, 0.010649]) and the depth-3 tree 0.003002; model minus logistic -0.002207 with a paired interval [-0.003707, -0.000752] entirely below 0, and the model's lead over the logistic by rung was [0.0063, 0.0126, 0.0054, 0.0014], 0.0014 at the top. The top rung was 0021's whole fit block - every chunk of the five pinned files that the sealed evaluation set does not use - so the record held no more real plaintexts, and 0023 named 'a second decade' and 'more real content than 0021's fit block (no such corpus exists in the record)' as what it did not cover. Two questions follow directly from its numbers. First, whether the rise continues when the added plaintexts are OTHER files of the same families, which is the only way real content can ever grow (0023's rise was measured on the scored files' own unscored chunks). Second, whether the linear rule, which bought more per doubling than the model over the first decade, overtakes it: if both of 0023's straight lines simply continued they would cross before the first new doubling (that arithmetic is sealed as informational under reference_slopes_informational and is not quoted in any document). This run builds the corpus that lets both be asked: 23 new archives and 600 new RFC texts, pinned, with licences filed and two COULD NOT VERIFY entries stated (docs/compliance/EXT_SOURCES2.md), cut into 7574 plaintexts with rows that share no whole chunk and no kilobyte run with anything 0018 pinned, and nested on 0021's block in exact doublings of every family.
scope.what_this_is_and_is_not: Neither a transfer reading nor 0023's in-distribution reading. Every rung holds the scored files' own unscored chunks (0021's block, rung 4); the plaintexts added above rung 4 are other projects' files of the same five families (other Python projects' .py and .rst, other C projects' .c and .h, other Windows programs' .exe, other RFCs), and the scored rows are still 0018's chunks of the original five files. Nothing fitted shares a whole chunk, a kilobyte run at any offset, a chunk index, a chunk id or a source-chunk hash with anything scored, and the two fit corpora share nothing with each other; the corpus builder proves the first two and the runner re-measures the rest (chunk ids, source hashes, and a digest of every scored feature row against every fit row of both corpora) and refuses on any overlap. The second decade therefore CONFOUNDS two things the design cannot separate: more plaintexts, and plaintexts from other files - a flat or falling second decade can be saturation or source shift, and the shift arm (rung 5's new plaintexts alone, rung 4's count) is the run's one direct reading of the shift, informational. The composition is lopsided and stated: pe_bin's new plaintexts are 0.59 Go-toolchain binaries and 0.38 the single file node.exe by bytes; c_src's are 0.73 PostgreSQL. A pass on the curve clause says that, at these recipes, the held-out accuracy on the original files keeps rising at 0.005 per doubling ('the record's rate' in this document always means that bar, never 0023's measured 0.007344) as more real files of the same kinds are fitted; a fail says it does not, and the reader names a falling decade as such. The lead reading says whether, at eight times 0021's plaintexts, the boosted recipe still beats a rule a person can write out, on the sealed rule's terms. Neither says anything about content of a kind the model has never seen (0015, 0018, 0019), about carve sizes other than 4096, or about a buyer. Rungs 1..4 are 0023's rungs row for row and must reproduce 0023's readings before any new plaintext is fitted: a machinery that no longer reproduces the first decade is not allowed to measure the second.
scope.why_rungs_are_exact_doublings_nested_on_: Rung 4 + d holds 0021's whole block plus, per family, the first n_f x (2^d - 1) chunks with rows of 0024's seeded pool, n_f being the family's chunks with rows in 0021's block: every rung therefore holds exactly 2^d times rung 4's plaintexts of every family, the family mix of 0021's block is preserved to the chunk (py_src carries r1 0.6486, r2 0.6538, r3 0.6543, r4 0.6527, r5 0.6527, r6 0.6525, r7 0.6528 of the rows), a lower rung is a subset of the next, and the abscissa is exact. The pool order is the nesting order, so the rungs are one corpus growing rather than three draws. The rows of a new rung are permuted whole by a sealed stream so that M4's last-10 percent validation split is a random tenth of the rung; rungs 1..4 keep 0023's order (the reproduction). Three doublings, not more, because py_src - 0.6527 of 0021's rows - needed 4704 new plaintexts with rows and the fourteen pinned Python projects yield 5781 candidate chunks; a fourth doubling would need 10080.

rungs.imbalance_stated_in_advance: every rung inherits 0021's family mix by construction; per-family slopes are banked as flags and c_src's rung 4 is 24 plaintexts, so its per-family slope is the noisiest number in the artifact and carries no verdict

design.fits: in the sealed order, which the reader enforces on the ledger: the null control (M4 on the top rung with its labels permuted by the sealed stream; it also probes the largest block first), then rung 4's depth-3 tree, logistic and model (the reproduction of 0021 and of 0023's top rung), then rungs 1, 2 and 3 (the reproduction of 0023's curve) - every one of the twelve first-decade readings checked within tolerance before any new plaintext is fitted - then rungs 5, 6 and 7 ascending, the model last within each rung, then the shift arm; each fit scored once on the 321409-row scoring set. 25 fits, 25 scorings.
design.shift_arm: rung 5's new plaintexts alone - per family the first n_f chunks with rows of 0024's pool, none of 0021's block - with rows permuted by np.random.default_rng([20260917, 150]); informational: read beside rung 4 (the same plaintext count, the scored files' own chunks) as a direct reading of what other files of the same families buy for the original files. 1029 plaintexts, 26420 rows: exactly rung 5's new chunks, so no extra plaintext is drawn for it. Its readings, its difference from rung 4 (what other files buy for the original files at the same plaintext count) and its difference from rung 5 (what the original files' own chunks add on top of it) are banked as flags.
design.curve: for each role, the seven real-family top-1 readings (4 decimals) against log2(plaintexts); the SECOND-decade slope by ordinary least squares over rungs 4..7 in accuracy per doubling of plaintexts (6 decimals) is the clause's number; the first-decade slope over rungs 1..4 (which must equal 0023's when the readings reproduce exactly) and the both-decade slope over all seven are flags; end-to-end and rung-to-rung gains; per-family second-decade slopes; the reverse curve on the builder's evaluation set. The bootstrap of the bar's clause: the sealed cluster bootstrap over scored real chunks, the same resamples for every role, so the model-minus-logistic slope difference carries a paired interval.
design.lead: at the top rung, model minus logistic real-family top-1 with a paired cluster-bootstrap interval from the same resamples, read by the sealed lead rule into MODEL_LEADS, LINEAR_LEADS or NO_SEPARATION, which the verdict string carries as its suffix. The same reading at rung 4 (where 0021 fixed the difference at 0.0014) and against the tree are flags. 0023's 'the model leads at every rung' and 0021's 0.0014 are point readings; the rung-4 interval here reads whether that point difference is separated from 0 on the scored chunks. NO_SEPARATION at rung 4 revises neither sentence and is published beside them as 'not separated at this size'. A role at its iteration cap at the top rung is named beside the lead and the lead is then not quoted as a recipe comparison (the rule's own clause).
design.readings: 0023's readings shape for every role; the curves, the slopes, the bootstrap and the leads are banked by the runner and recomputed by the reader from the per-example vectors and the sealed chunk layout.
design.how_the_difference_flag_is_read: stated in advance: the paired model-minus-logistic SLOPE interval over the second decade entirely above 0 reads 'the model buys more per doubling of new files than the linear rule'; entirely below 0 reads 'the linear rule buys more'; an interval that includes 0 reads 'not resolved at this size', never 'equal'. Unlike 0023, the top rung is not pinned to a banked difference, so this flag and the lead reading are two different questions: the rate over the decade and the standing at its end. The share of resamples with the model ahead is a description of the resamples, not a probability. A role at its iteration cap at any rung is named beside every quotation of that role's slope, and the difference flag is not read as a recipe comparison in that case.
design.what_the_0021_bar_flag_is: 0021's clause (best trivial baseline on the same rows plus 0.05) re-applied at the top rung, banked twice and labelled: against the depth-3 tree plus 0.05 (the tree stood in for the best of 0021's four baselines; the other three read below it at 0021 and are not refitted here, so that flag can only be optimistic), and against the higher of the tree and the standardised logistic plus 0.05 (OPERATING_RULES 4a names logistic regression among the trivial baselines; 0021's four did not include it, and L3 is fitted at every rung here). Neither is a verdict.
design.what_the_second_decade_reading_is: the reader names what the second-decade slope did beside any FLAT: a slope whose scored-chunk interval sits entirely below 0 is published as 'adding files of the same kinds lowered the model's reading on the original files', beside the per-family second-decade slopes and the shift arm; a slope between 0 and the bar as 'below the record's rate; whether it is flat is not resolved here'.
design.sensitivity: the second-decade slope with rung 4 held at 0021's banked reading is banked per role (0023's precedent): a drift inside the 0.005 reproduction tolerance at rung 4 moves the four-point slope by up to 0.0015 per doubling, 30 percent of the bar.

rival_explanations_run_as_arms: 'the curve is a change of family mix': the new rungs are exact doublings of every family on 0021's block, so every rung has 0021's mix.

'a rise is the boosted recipe alone': the logistic and the depth-3 tree are fitted at every rung under the same rule; the model-minus-logistic slope difference carries a paired interval, and the lead at the top rung is read by the sealed rule.

'the machinery is not 0023's': rungs 1..4 are 0023's row for row and their twelve readings must land within 0.005 of 0023's banked values (rung 4's within 0.005 of 0021's); the runner files NOT RUN on the first drift it sees, which by the sealed order is rung 4, before any new plaintext is fitted.

'the new files leak the scored content': every candidate chunk of the new files was hashed against every whole chunk of every 0018 pinned blob and dropped on identity (none was); the runner re-measures chunk ids, source hashes and byte-identical feature rows against everything scored and refuses on any overlap; the null control on the top rung, with the new rows in it, must sit at chance.

'the rise is scoring noise': the clause requires the cluster-bootstrap 95 percent lower bound of the second-decade slope over the scored real chunks to sit above 0, and the slope itself at or above 0.005 per doubling; the lead rule requires a paired interval clear of 0 before either recipe is said to lead.
'more rows, not more plaintexts': a rung takes every row of its plaintexts, so rows and plaintexts grow together by construction and the artifact says so; separating them is not in scope.

'the new files are easier or harder than the original ones, or the second decade is source shift rather than saturation': not separable by the curve alone - the scored rows are the original files' chunks throughout, so a change of slope between the decades is a change in what the added plaintexts buy for the original files, and the second-minus-first decade slope per role is banked as a flag with exactly that reading; the shift arm (rung 5's new plaintexts alone at rung 4's count, three informational fits) reads the shift directly against rung 4.

'a kilobyte of a scored file sits in a new file at another offset': every candidate chunk was scanned for a 1024-byte run shared with any 0018 pinned blob at any alignment and dropped on a hit (counts per family sealed); runs shorter than that, and paraphrased revisions, are stated as not excluded.

cost.estimate_stated_in_advance: a range, from banked numbers. Linear in rows from 0023's rung-4 seconds: model about r1 45 s, r2 90 s, r3 178 s, r4 356 s, r5 712 s, r6 1420 s, r7 2844 s; logistic about r1 8 s, r2 16 s, r3 33 s, r4 66 s, r5 131 s, r6 262 s, r7 524 s; trees seconds; the null on the top rung about 927 s; the shift arm about rung 4's; in all about 8097 s of fits (2.2 hours). The cap-bound: 0023 banked 5.734 s per iteration for the model and 0.167 s for the logistic at rung 4 (62 and 392 iterations), and the model's iteration count grew with rows over the first decade ([31, 36, 47, 62]); if the new rungs run to the sealed caps (250 and 1000) with per-iteration time scaling with rows, the new rungs cost r5 2871 s, r6 5725 s, r7 11467 s for the model and r5 334 s, r6 667 s, r7 1336 s for the logistic, 24604 s in all (6.8 hours). Between 2.2 and 6.8 hours of fits on this machine at three threads, plus the scoring-set materialisation, the row-identity scan over both fit corpora and twenty-five scorings; the top rung's model fit is one uncheckpointable stretch of up to that size. COULD NOT VERIFY until run - the banked seconds are the measurement.
cost.what_a_kill_between_scoring_and_banking_: run_recipe_search.run_fit scores a fit, refills the block if it was standardised, and only then writes the checkpoint and the 'completed' event; a kill inside that window leaves no trace, the relaunch refits and rescores the role, and the reader's 'exactly one completion' check cannot see the first scoring (inherited from 0023's runner; stated rather than fixed, because the shared runner is behind frozen readers).
cost.what_the_smoke_touches: the smoke fits on scratchpad corpora and writes to the scratchpad only, but it hashes the sealed builder cache and scores on 0003's sealed evaluation rows (as 0023's did); the disclosure counts it.
cost.memory: the top rung's float64 block is about 1.87 GB, the two fit corpora in float32 about 0.98 GB and the scoring set 1.42 GB; the sealed memory_kill_gb is 13.0 on a 15 GB machine
cost.checkpoints: artifacts/pivot/realcurve2_4096_ckpt; resume by relaunching the identical command

scope.expected_outcome_stated_in_advance: On the curve: SECOND_DECADE_RISES, more likely than not, but less likely than 0023's pass was. For: 0023's second half rose at 0.007344 per doubling with an interval [0.006199, 0.00846] well clear of the bar, and the new content is the same five kinds. Against: 0023's rise was measured on the scored files' own unscored chunks; every reading the record has of content the model did not see is flat (0018/0019, 0015), and the new files are other projects - the per-plaintext rate on other files could be anywhere between 0023's and 0. On the lead: LINEAR_LEADS or NO_SEPARATION, more likely than MODEL_LEADS. For: over the first decade the logistic bought 0.002207 more per doubling than the model with a paired interval entirely below 0, the model's lead shrank to 0.0014 at rung 4, and the straight lines cross before the first new doubling (arithmetic sealed under reference_slopes_informational). Against: the model's rung-to-rung gains fell over the first decade while the logistic's did not, which could as easily reverse on new files; and the paired interval of a difference of about 0.005 over 38452 rows in 1500 chunks may include 0. Either outcome on either question is published at the same size in the same places; the verdict string names both.
scope.what_a_fail_would_mean_for_the_record: SECOND_DECADE_FLAT closes the budget excuse on real content the honest way: adding real files of the same kinds does not buy the recipe the record's rate on the files it is scored on. LINEAR_LEADS means that at eight times 0021's plaintexts the boosted recipe is behind a rule a person can write out on the record's own real content - the manufactured-label headline (0003, 0014) is not revised, but the claim that the recipe is what the data buys is. Both are stated at full size wherever the record states 0023's rise.
scope.what_this_does_not_cover: Any carve size other than 4096; any recipe other than 0021's three; transfer to content of a kind the model has never seen; a second seed or nesting of the new rungs, and no replicate of any new rung (0023 replicated its smallest rung; here the smallest new draw is 1029 plaintexts and the fit-side variance of the second decade is unmeasured, which the scored-chunk interval does not cover); the shape of the curve beyond a straight line in log2(plaintexts) per decade; the rows-versus-plaintexts decomposition; separating saturation from source shift beyond the one informational shift arm; a per-family verdict; a per-archive verdict; a re-fit of 0021's four trivial baselines at the top rung (the 0021-bar flags use the tree, and the higher of the tree and the logistic); shared runs shorter than 1024 bytes and paraphrased revisions between new and scored files; a third decade; anything about a buyer.

top_rung_against_0021s_bar_with_the_tree_as_floor and top_rung_against_0021s_bar_with_the_higher_of_tree_and_logistic_as_floor: the model at the top rung against each floor plus 0.05

roles_at_iteration_cap_at_the_top_rung and lead_at_top_is_a_recipe_comparison; second_decade_reading (the named reading of a slope below the bar or below 0)

scope.sealed_set_disclosure: This is the eleventh preregistration scored on 0003's sealed evaluation set (0003 12 times, 0006 for top-k, 0014 10 plus 10 in a smoke, 0015 27 plus smokes, 0016 258 plus smokes, 0017 10 plus smokes, 0018 4, 0021 11 plus 6 in a smoke, 0022 12 plus 9 in a smoke, 0023 16 plus 29 in smokes); 0024 adds 25 scorings of the sealed evaluation set and of the 61409-row extension corpus, and uses the sealed evaluation set as the reverse reading and as the null control's second row set. Its pre-freeze smokes scored the whole sealed evaluation set 47 more times with small fits (22 under the first instrument before the pre-freeze review, 25 under this one; 0023's 16-per-family smoke corpus plus a 126-per-family smoke of the new corpus, scratchpad only) and 832 of the extension rows (520 of them clause rows). The readings are committed in tests/fixtures/realcurve2_runner_shape.json and are used for nothing but the gate's control shape.

fit_corpus_described.convention: n_chunks in fit_corpus is the number of source chunks that CARRY ROWS, which is what the runner measures (1029); 1035 chunks were selected and 6 of them produced no row because every one of their 26 streams fell below the 4096-byte carve floor. The sealed extension corpus uses the same convention (n_chunks 2387 with rows, 2400 built).

fit2_corpus_described.pool_rule: per family, 0021's chunks-with-rows x (2^doublings - 1) x (1 + pool_margin) + pool_extra candidate chunks are built, in the seeded order; the margin covers chunks that yield no row, so that the preregistration can cut exact doublings of plaintexts with rows
fit2_corpus_described.selection_rule: per family: every whole chunk of the family blob (pinned archives in sorted name order, matching members in sorted name order) whose bytes hash to no whole chunk of any 0018 pinned blob, share no run of 1024 bytes with any 0018 pinned blob at any offset (exclusion.run_overlap), and hash to no earlier candidate of any family, in blob order; np.random.default_rng([seed, family_index + 1]) permutes those candidates and the first pool_size are built, in that order

run_overlap.hash: polynomial mod 2^64, base 0x9E3779B97F4A7C15|1, H(i) = sum_k b[i+k] * base^k
run_overlap.rule: a candidate chunk is dropped if run_windows consecutive window-byte windows aligned to its own grid, none constant (all bytes equal), each occur at ANY offset of ANY 0018 pinned blob; run_windows x window = 1024 shared bytes

fit2_corpus_described.exclusion_is: n_distinct_chunk_hashes_of_0018_pinned_blobs is the size of the whole-chunk hash set (two of the 0018 blobs' whole chunks repeat another's bytes, so it is below n_whole_chunks_of_0018_pinned_blobs); run_overlap is the second rule, added after the pre-freeze review found node.exe carrying the same OpenSSL build as 0018's libcrypto DLL: a candidate chunk sharing 1024 bytes with any 0018 pinned blob at any offset is dropped, counted per family above

rule.note: the three pinned archives carry .exe members only (Go's toolchain binaries, node.exe, PuTTY's programs); no .dll matches

fit2_corpus_described.licences: docs/compliance/EXT_SOURCES2.md; every archive's licence text is committed under docs/compliance/sources/
fit2_corpus_described.disjointness: by bytes and at every offset: every candidate chunk is dropped if it equals any whole chunk of any 0018 pinned blob or shares a run of 1024 bytes with one at any alignment; `corpus_realfit2.py --disjoint` proves the exclusion set covers every real source hash of 0018's sealed corpus and of 0021's fit corpus, that this corpus shares no chunk id and no source hash with either, and re-scans every built chunk for the run rule; the runner re-measures chunk ids, source hashes and byte-identical feature rows against everything scored and against 0021's block. What is NOT excluded, stated: runs shorter than 1024 bytes (boilerplate lines, short code sequences) and text that revises a scored document without copying a kilobyte of it verbatim; RFCs related to a 0018-pinned RFC by an Obsoletes or Updates annotation were removed from the sample for that reason
fit2_corpus_described.what_the_new_plaintexts_are: by bytes of the family blobs (the manifest's composition): pe_bin is 0.59 the Go toolchain's nineteen binaries, 0.38 the single file node.exe and 0.04 PuTTY's six programs - executables, where 0018's pe_bin was mostly DLLs; c_src is 0.73 PostgreSQL by bytes against a scored SQLite amalgamation; py_src and rst_doc come from fourteen PyPI projects; rfc_txt from 600 RFCs across the whole series

bar.lead_rule: the 95 percent paired cluster-bootstrap interval of model minus logistic real-family top-1 at the top rung, over the scored real chunks with the slope bootstrap's own resamples: entirely above 0 is MODEL_LEADS, entirely below 0 is LINEAR_LEADS, otherwise NO_SEPARATION (never 'equal'); the verdict string carries it as a suffix. If the model or the logistic at the top rung is at its iteration cap, the suffix is still read by the rule, but every document that states it states '(the <role> at its iteration cap at the top rung)' in the same sentence and the lead is not quoted as a recipe comparison, exactly as the difference flag is not

bootstrap.rule: cluster bootstrap over the SCORED real-family chunks: np.random.default_rng(seed) draws n chunks with replacement per resample; every second-decade rung's accuracy on the resample is rounded to 4 decimals and the OLS slope against log2(plaintexts) over rungs 4..7 refitted; one resample serves every rung and every role, so role differences are paired; the 2.5th and 97.5th percentiles are the interval. The lead at the top rung uses the same generator construction and draw order (the same resamples): the difference of the two roles' rounded accuracies per resample. The interval is over the scored chunks only: it says how far the slope or the lead moves if a different sample of held-out chunks of the same files is scored. It does not resample the fit side - which new plaintexts fell into which rung (one seed, one nesting), or where early stopping halted.

reference_slopes_informational.top_rung_if_0023s_lines_continued_is: arithmetic on banked numbers, not a prediction the record stands behind: 0021's reading plus 0023's slope times 3.0 doublings, per role; the added plaintexts are other files, and 0023's slope was measured on the scored files' own chunks. Sealed here as informational only: no document quotes these numbers (0023's closing sentence and this file's stop rules forbid quoting an extrapolation beyond a top rung)
reference_slopes_informational.note: informational references for the prose and the flags; none is a clause

model.why: capacity plus regularisation plus a lower rate together: 800000 rows x 26 classes supports bigger trees than 63 leaves, and the deep-tree baseline gained 0.1459 -> 0.1812 from depth 8 to 16 at 4096

logistic.why: standardised inputs with C 1.0: the single most standard fix for an lbfgs logistic on 1108 unscaled hand-engineered columns

depth3_tree.why: 0003's depth3_tree verbatim (DecisionTreeClassifier(max_depth=3, random_state=0), gini, min_samples_leaf 1): 0.0969 banked

scope.recipes_source: prereg/0023-realcurve-4096.json scope.curve.recipes verbatim (0022's recipes_reference: M4, L3, D1; 0021's params)

fit_block.rule: every row of the fit corpus, in the np.random.default_rng(20260825) permutation of range(n_rows), so the recipes' last-10% validation split is a random tenth rather than one family
fit_block.order_rule: np.random.default_rng(20260825).permutation of the fit corpus's rows, so the recipes' last-10% validation split is a random tenth rather than one family (0021's fit block)

source_chunks.source: distinct source-chunk sha256 values behind each corpus: 0023's runner banked the first two; the third is the count of distinct meta_src_sha256 values in 0024's corpus, one per built chunk

rungs.row_order_rule: np.random.default_rng([20260917, 105]).permutation over [0021's fit block in its order] + [26346 + 0024 rows of the rung's chunks in npz order]

np.random.default_rng([20260917, 107]).permutation over [0021's fit block in its order] + [26346 + 0024 rows of the rung's chunks in npz order]

sealed_partition.rung_rule: stratified_nested_by_family_chunk: per family, np.random.default_rng([seed, family_index + 1]) permutes its chunk ids with rows; rung d takes the first ceil(n_f / d); rows are the fit block's rows of those chunks in fit-block order
sealed_partition.second_decade_rule: lockstep_nested_on_0021_block: rung 4 + d is 0021's whole fit block plus, per family, the first n_f x (2^d - 1) chunks with rows of 0024's pool in pool order (chunk id ascending), n_f being the family's chunks with rows in 0021's block; every rung therefore holds exactly 2^d x n_f plaintexts of every family; rows are permuted by np.random.default_rng([seed2, 100 + rung])

shift_arm.rule: rung 5's new plaintexts alone - per family the first n_f chunks with rows of 0024's pool, none of 0021's block - with rows permuted by np.random.default_rng([20260917, 150]); informational: read beside rung 4 (the same plaintext count, the scored files' own chunks) as a direct reading of what other files of the same families buy for the original files

sealed_partition.early_stopping_split_disclosed: M4 takes the LAST 10 percent of its block's rows, in block order, as the early-stopping validation split (0014's roster, 0021's fit). Rungs 1..4 keep 0023's row order; rungs 5..7 are permuted whole by their sealed stream so the tenth is a random tenth of the rung; the shift arm's rows are permuted whole too. Measured here per rung, not assumed: r1 (3344 rows): 335 validation rows over 119 chunks, 119 also in the training nine tenths (contamination 1.0); r2 (6635 rows): 664 validation rows over 240 chunks, 240 also in the training nine tenths (contamination 1.0); r3 (13207 rows): 1321 validation rows over 485 chunks, 485 also in the training nine tenths (contamination 1.0); r4 (26346 rows): 2635 validation rows over 968 chunks, 968 also in the training nine tenths (contamination 1.0); r5 (52766 rows): 5277 validation rows over 1917 chunks, 1917 also in the training nine tenths (contamination 1.0); r6 (105214 rows): 10522 validation rows over 3818 chunks, 3818 also in the training nine tenths (contamination 1.0); r7 (210751 rows): 21076 validation rows over 7622 chunks, 7620 also in the training nine tenths (contamination 0.9997); s4 (26420 rows): 2642 validation rows over 940 chunks, 940 also in the training nine tenths (contamination 1.0). A contaminated validation split lets early stopping run long, which lowers a held-out reading rather than raising it; the iteration counts are banked flags.

curve_arithmetic.passes_if: For each role the reader recomputes the seven rung readings, the second-decade, first-decade and both-decade OLS slopes against the sealed log2(plaintexts) (6 decimals), the end-to-end and rung-to-rung gains, the per-family and reverse slopes, the bootstrap (the sealed rule, seed and resample count, from the per-example vectors and the sealed extension chunk layout) and the four lead intervals; each banked value must equal the recomputed one exactly (the recomputation is the runner's own arithmetic on the same integers). The verdict is read on the reader's own slope, interval and lead. Otherwise VOID.

slope.passes_if: the model's SECOND-decade slope, in real-family accuracy per doubling of plaintexts over rungs 4..7, >= 0.005. The bar is 0023's restated, a design choice made before any second-decade number exists: the rise the record agreed in 0016 and 0023 to call a rise, about two thirds of 0023's measured 0.007344 and about half the builder's per-plaintext rate. It is not the instrument's resolution: 0023's scored-chunk intervals were about 0.0011 per doubling wide either side. 'The record's rate' in this document always means 0.005 per doubling; the second-minus-first-decade slope is quoted in the same sentence as any pass. 0.005 over 3.0 doublings is an end-to-end rise of 0.015, 577 rows of 38452. A pass is 'keeps rising at the bar on other files of the same kinds', not 'rises like the first decade'.

slope_bootstrap.passes_if: the 2.5th percentile of the model's second-decade slope under the sealed cluster bootstrap over the scored real chunks is > 0. The interval is over the scored chunks only and does not resample the fit side; a slope at or above the bar whose interval reaches 0 is SECOND_DECADE_FLAT: four points and a rise the scored chunks do not agree on is not a rise.

lead_rule.passes_if: the 95 percent paired cluster-bootstrap interval of model minus logistic real-family top-1 at the top rung, over the scored real chunks with the slope bootstrap's own resamples: entirely above 0 is MODEL_LEADS, entirely below 0 is LINEAR_LEADS, otherwise NO_SEPARATION (never 'equal'); the verdict string carries it as a suffix. If the model or the logistic at the top rung is at its iteration cap, the suffix is still read by the rule, but every document that states it states '(the <role> at its iteration cap at the top rung)' in the same sentence and the lead is not quoted as a recipe comparison, exactly as the difference flag is not. This is not a pass/fail clause: each of the three readings is a legitimate outcome and the verdict string carries whichever the interval gives, beside the curve part. No document quotes the curve part without the lead part.

shift_arm_informational.passes_if: the shift arm's three readings, their differences from rung 4 and from rung 5 are banked, recomputed by the reader, and published beside the verdict wherever the second-decade slope is; never a verdict.

flags_informational.passes_if: the logistic's and the tree's slopes and intervals, the paired slope-difference intervals and shares, the first- and both-decade slopes, the sensitivity slopes, the leads at rung 4 and over the tree, per-family slopes, gains, the two 0021-bar flags, the cap flags, the second-decade reading and the reverse curve are banked beside the verdict in every document that states it, with all seven rung readings per role. Never a verdict.

arms: THE SECOND DECADE: 0021's M4 fitted on rungs 4..7 (r4: 1029 plaintexts; r5: 2058 plaintexts; r6: 4116 plaintexts; r7: 8232 plaintexts) and scored on the 38452 real-family rows; slope by OLS against log2(plaintexts); cluster bootstrap over the scored real chunks.

THE LINEAR RULE AND THE TREE ON THE SAME RUNGS: 0021's L3 and D1 under the identical rule; the model-minus-logistic slope difference carries a paired interval, and the lead at the top rung is read by the sealed rule into the verdict string.

REPRODUCTION FIRST: rung 4 is 0021's fit block row for row and its three roles must read within 0.005 of 0021's banked values, and rungs 1..3 are 0023's and must read within 0.005 of 0023's - all twelve before any new plaintext is fitted.
NULL CONTROL: M4 on the top rung with its labels permuted by the sealed stream, hash for hash, first in the order; must sit at chance.

THE SHIFT ARM, LAST: rung 5's new plaintexts alone at rung 4's count, all three recipes; its difference from rung 4 is the direct reading of what other files of the same families buy for the original files. Informational.

VALIDITY FIRST: a wrong corpus, set, rung, recipe or protocol, a role scored twice, two roles sharing a vector, a reproduction outside 0.005 at any of the twelve first-decade readings, a leaking null control, or a slope, interval or lead that does not recompute is VOID and brackets nothing.
stop_rules: Either slope clause failing is SECOND_DECADE_FLAT (with its lead suffix), published at the same size as a pass would have been, in VERDICT.md, README.md, the outbound documents, DILIGENCE.md and the evidence page, with the seven rung readings per role, the three second-decade slopes and their intervals, the paired model-minus-logistic interval read by the sealed rule, the shift arm, and the lead at the top rung beside it; the published sentence names which clause failed (the slope, the interval, or both). A second-decade slope whose scored-chunk interval sits entirely below 0 is published with the sentence 'adding files of the same kinds lowered the model's reading on the original files', beside the per-family second-decade slopes and the shift arm; a slope between 0 and the bar is published as 'below the record's rate; whether it is flat is not resolved here'.

No sealed parameter, rung, corpus hash, row count, bar or lead rule changes after the freeze; a defect found afterwards is a new preregistration (0013's, 0019's and 0021's precedent), never an edit to a frozen file.

A validity or control failure is VOID: the clause is named, nothing is counted in either direction (the verdict file's slope, interval and lead are null on VOID); a VOID run may be resumed from its checkpoints under the identical invocation and is never re-parameterised.

NOT RUN is reachable only by mechanical rules (three consecutive launches with no new checkpoint before the first checkpoint exists; a first-decade role outside 0.005 of its banked reading; the null control's permuted labels not hashing to the sealed array, or the null control above chance + 0.01; a role that banks no per-example vector); it is filed as artifacts/pivot/realcurve2_4096_not_run.json, the reader prints it and exits 2, and nothing is re-scoped to fewer rungs, fewer doublings or a lower bar. A failed launch precondition is a refusal: it exits 3 before any checkpoint exists and is filed by the operator in the engineering log; the runner re-samples a 1-minute load above 2.0 for up to five minutes before refusing on it. An artifact banked complete is never rewritten: a relaunch refuses.

Neither outcome revises the numbers of 0003, 0014, 0015, 0016, 0017, 0018, 0019, 0021, 0022 or 0023; SECOND_DECADE_FLAT bounds 0023's published sentence 'the record's scaling thesis holds on real files' to the scored files' own chunks, and that sentence receives a forward pointer in VERDICT.md and DILIGENCE.md on publication; establishes_a_buyer is emitted False on every path.

No number from this run is quoted as a transfer reading; no extrapolation beyond the top rung is quoted as anything (the sealed informational arithmetic under reference_slopes_informational included); the curve part of the verdict is never quoted without the lead part; every document that states the verdict states that the 'second decade' is three doublings (0.9031 of a decade) of other files above 0021's block, that both together span 1.8016 decades, short of 0003's two-decade scope rule, and states LINEAR_LEADS and NO_SEPARATION at the size MODEL_LEADS would have had; and every document that states either part states what the plaintexts above rung 4 are.
thesis: The manufactured-label thesis asked of real content, one decade further: if the encoder signal on real files keeps rising when the files fitted are other files of the same kinds, the budget was the excuse and buying real content is the road; if it does not, the excuse closes; and in either case the record says, at eight times 0021's plaintexts, whether the boosted recipe or a hand-writable linear rule is ahead - at full size, in the verdict string itself.
